description: Abstract base class for handling database query results in Drupal, providing methods for fetching and processing result sets.

classes.name: ResultBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing core functionality for database query result handling, including fetching rows, setting fetch modes, and converting result sets.

methods.name: rowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows matched by the last SQL statement, or throws an exception if the last statement was a SELECT.

methods.name: setFetchMode
methods.description: Sets the default fetch mode for the result set.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches the next row from the result set, formatted according to the specified fetch mode.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Returns all rows in the result set as an array.

methods.name: fetchAllKeyed
methods.description: Returns the result set as an associative array keyed by a specified column.

methods.name: fetchAllAssoc
methods.description: Returns the entire result set as an associative array keyed by a specified column.
